I was pleased to see that they had replaced the mattresses, linens, bedsheets, and pillows—everything felt fresher, cleaner, and more comfortable. The room was well-maintained, and the staff was courteous and helpful throughout my stay.

The location in Karol Bagh is very convenient for shopping and metro access. Overall, it was a great value for money. I would definitely consider staying here again. The manager at Day, Brahmadev, I like it. This person is a very hardworking guy.☺

Considering the location in Karol Bagh and the comfort provided, it is definitely value for money. Would recommend it to business and family travelers alike.
